secrets.name: SESSION_SECRET
secrets.description: Secret key used for signing session cookies, hashing passwords, and CSRF tokens. Must be at least 32 characters. A development placeholder is generated automatically; replace with a strong random string for production.

secrets.name: FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY
secrets.description: Legacy Firebase service account key. Firebase has been fully removed from the app — this secret is no longer needed and can be deleted from the dashboard.
